description: Dated changes to one app's listing — new version, screenshots, in-app events, featuring from the store page, and keyword-field edits from App Store Connect — each with the keyword rank movement around it: terms that went up, down, entered or dropped between the last measurement before the change and the last one within `window` days after, plus the five biggest moves.

country.description: country code, e.g. tr, us (defaults to the app's first country)

window.description: days after each change to read ranks, up to 30 (default 7)

name: get_listing_timeline
